defs.def: a thick cloud of very small drops of water in the air close to the land or sea, that is very difficult to see through 雾

ex.s: Smog comes from the words “smoke” and “fog”, and it is used to describe the air pollution in cities caused mainly by traffic and factories.
ex.t: 烟雾这个词来自"烟"和"雾"，用来描述主要由交通和工厂引起的城市空气污染。

defs.def: a state of confusion, in which things are not clear 迷惘；困惑
if a glass surface fogs or is fogged up, it becomes covered in steam or small drops of water so that you cannot see through （使）雾气笼罩
to make sb/sth confused or less clear 使迷惘；使困惑
